issues.where: dive-to-terrain cover, frames 739-743, lower left and center
issues.what: a second misregistered terrain plate shows through as a hard-edged rectangle with doubled crater rims and a doubled limb line; the cover reads as two images laid over each other, not one move
issues.fix: drive both sides of the cover from one continuous camera path so the plates register exactly, or replace the dissolve with a single continuous render through the descent

issues.what: the sun pops in above the horizon and the horizon swings from a limb at the right to a wide arc across the top; direction and composition jump within the cover
issues.fix: keep the sun and limb continuous through the descent and pitch the camera up smoothly so the sun rises into frame over several frames

issues.what: the sun disappears and the horizon tilt flips between 994 and 1000; between 1021 and 1027 the globe shrinks sharply, the sun moves, and a Milky Way band pops in at upper left
issues.fix: ease the pull-back with a continuous camera path, keep the sun and background stars locked to world space, and have the galactic band in the sky the whole time rather than switching it on

issues.where: terrain-to-rise cover, frames 990-996, horizon and ground
issues.what: the horizon doubles into two parallel lines and exposure lifts to a flat washed grey; the ground smears into streaky ghost copies instead of a smooth directional blur
issues.fix: use one camera with real motion blur across the cover, keep exposure matched on both sides, and keep the cover from crossfading two horizons that are out of register

issues.what: crater rims break into stepped bright copies with colored speckle, so the blur ghosts instead of smearing smoothly; the texture looks like it is being zoomed as a flat image
issues.fix: render true per-pixel motion blur with more samples and stream the higher-detail terrain in early so the dive does not upscale a low-res texture

issues.what: small white dash specks sit inside the crater's black shadow and move from frame to frame, which reads as crawling noise
issues.fix: clamp the specular highlights or fireflies in the shadowed area and denoise them consistently over time

issues.what: the starburst rays change length and strength noticeably while the camera barely moves
issues.fix: tie the flare's strength to how much of the sun is visible and smooth that over time

issues.what: the near ground and the horizon have only weak parallax, so the view reads close to a slow pan over a single surface
issues.fix: lower the camera and add some lateral travel so the near craters slide clearly against the horizon
